## Why work with me

<div class="feature-grid three">
<div class="feature-card"><i class="bi bi-diagram-3 ic"></i><h3>Numbers and narratives</h3><p>I work in both quantitative tools (SPSS, Stata, R, Python) and qualitative tools (NVivo, ATLAS.ti), so your evidence has both the scale and the story.</p></div>
<div class="feature-card"><i class="bi bi-shield-check ic"></i><h3>Work you can check</h3><p>Methods are documented and analyses are reproducible. I state limitations plainly and never present association as proof of cause.</p></div>
<div class="feature-card"><i class="bi bi-chat-left-text ic"></i><h3>Plain-language results</h3><p>You get findings that a programme manager, donor or board member can understand and use, not just tables of output.</p></div>
</div>
